name: Móricgát (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of yellow, white and yellow in the ratio 1:1:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Móricgát (a quartered shield of blue and yellow with trees, a church and waves) within a green wreath, above a scroll inscribed MÓRICGÁT 1993.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Móricgát arms with wreath and scroll
